revenue.rationale: Total revenue; 16 observations, latest 2026-07-26 (96,221M). Matches income statement.

diluted_shares.rationale: Weighted-average diluted shares; 16 observations, latest 2026-07-26 (24,285M). Non-additive.

cfo.rationale: 15 observations (year-to-date flows differenced into quarters), latest 2026-07-26 (24,077M for the quarter).

capex.rationale: PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment has no data in snapshot; this concept has 15 observations, latest 2026-07-26 (2,677M). Judgment: it is the company's purchases of property and equipment and intangible assets line.

sbc.rationale: Cash-flow add-back; 15 observations, latest 2026-07-26 (2,026M). AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense (16 obs, 2,027M) is a near-identical alternative; the cash-flow concept was preferred as it is consistent with cfo.

short_term_investments.rationale: Balance sheet reports marketable debt securities (DebtSecuritiesCurrent, 34,143M at 2026-07-26) and marketable equity securities (EquitySecuritiesFvNi, 42,783M) separately; summed = 76,926M. Each has 3 observations (2026-01-25, 2026-04-26, 2026-07-26), so the sum covers only those periods. MarketableSecuritiesCurrent (13 obs) is the earlier combined total and ends 2025-10-26 (stale); it is excluded to avoid double counting, since no period overlaps with the two parts. Pre-2026-01 history for this line is therefore absent from the sum (sum keeps only periods where both parts exist). Non-marketable securities (51,157M, non-current) are not included. Judgment: marketable equity securities are included as liquid investments; the valuation step may haircut them.

total_debt.rationale: 16 observations, latest 2026-07-26 (33,366M) = long-term debt 32,366M + short-term debt 1,000M per balance sheet, so it already includes the current portion. LongTermDebtNoncurrent (32,366M) would omit it; not summed to avoid double counting.
